theme: Reading Between the Lines (Idiomatic & Figurative Language)
phoneme_focus: Idiom chunking & connected speech; stress-timing in fixed expressions

grammar_point.title: Idiomatic & figurative language + deep collocation
grammar_point.en: Understand and use idioms, metaphor and strong collocations naturally and appropriately.
grammar_point.ar: فهم واستخدام التعابير الاصطلاحية والمجاز والمتلازمات القوية بشكل طبيعي ومناسب.

Saturday.prompt: Use five idioms naturally in short sentences.

Sunday.prompt: Explain a situation using metaphor and figurative language.

Monday.prompt: 'Read between the lines': infer the hidden meaning of three remarks.

Tuesday.prompt: Compare words with positive vs negative connotations.

Wednesday.prompt: Tell a short anecdote weaving in three idioms.

Thursday.prompt: Discuss a topic with a partner, using idioms and reading their tone.

Friday.prompt: Present a vivid, idiomatic talk (10-12 sentences) that uses figurative language well.

writing_prompts: Write five sentences each using a different idiom correctly.
Explain a situation using a metaphor and a figurative phrase.
Interpret three ambiguous remarks ('read between the lines').
Contrast the connotation of two near-synonyms.
Write a short anecdote using at least three idioms.
Write a colourful paragraph rich in idiomatic and figurative language.
